verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly state that integrating with Jira Service Management enables mapping incidents to deployments and automated change approval processes before releases, directly matching the story. However, this relies solely on first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on corroboration of how the approval gating actually works in practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification, detail on approval workflow mechanics, and broader deployment-gate documentation beyond the marketing blurb.
